answer.reason: The verses tell what Ahimelech did for David and how Saul condemned him for it.

clauses.english: gave David the hallowed bread and the sword of Goliath
clauses.quote: So the priest gave him hallowed bread

clauses.english: was sentenced to death by Saul, with all his father's house
clauses.quote: Thou shalt surely die, Ahimelech, thou, and all thy father's house.

doubts: His own death is not stated in so many words; only Saul's sentence on him and the slaying of the priests by Doeg are given, so the second clause rests on the sentence.
